comment: RESP wire vectors shared by the six clients. encode: the bytes a client writes for a command given as args (UTF-8 strings) or args_hex (raw bytes). decode: reply bytes and the decoded value. incomplete: replies cut short; the parser must ask for more data instead of returning a value. bytes holds the wire bytes as UTF-8 text; bytes_hex replaces it when they are not valid UTF-8. Values: simple, error, int (a decimal string beyond 2^53), bulk or bulk_hex, null, array. RESP2 only: the Rust and C# clients do not parse RESP3.

encode.name: short non-ASCII whose UTF-8 length has fewer digits than its worst case

decode.name: WRONGTYPE error
decode.bytes: -WRONGTYPE Operation against a key holding the wrong kind of value

value.error: WRONGTYPE Operation against a key holding the wrong kind of value

decode.name: array with binary and large bulks
